selection_rationale: Retain exactly one fixed-rule counterexample route and two complementary theorem routes. M25Q-7 has genuine post-training cycles but lacks a nondecaying amplitude proof; M25Q-15 is the strongest unconditional finite almost-packing input but lacks summable constants; M25Q-17 is the best structural route because both guarded seeds separated genuinely non-affine batches from the fixed-offset multiplication-table comparator. M25Q-17 is the recommended next target, with M25Q-15 as its remainder estimate and M25Q-7 held only as a bounded counterexample audit.
